xmldoc.short_description: Save figure including UI components as an image file.

param_input_item.param_description: figure object: figure or UI figure to capture.
a character vector or string scalar: destination image file.

description.p: exportapp(fig, filename) captures the figure fig, including all of its UI components, and writes it to the image file filename.
The output file format is determined by the extension of filename (for example .png, .jpg, or .tif).
Unlike saveas, exportapp is intended to export figures created with uifigure that contain UI components such as buttons, sliders, and tables.
